  end

  end

    self.token_digest = self.class.digest_token(raw_token)
    self.expires_at = EXPIRY.from_now
    raw_token

    class BaseController < ApplicationController

        end

        if @current_account.nil?

        end
      end

      def require_active_account!
        return if @current_account.nil?\n
        if @current_account.cancelled?
          render json: { error: "Account is cancelled" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_session!
        raw_token = extract_bearer_token
        @current_session = Session.authenticate_for_account(current_account, raw_token)
        if @current_session.nil?
          return render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
        end

        @current_user = @current_session.user
        if @current_user.suspended?
          render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
        end
      end

      def require_owner!
        return if current_user&.owner_of?(current_account)

        render json: { error: "Only the account owner can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
      end

      end

      def require_staff!
        return if current_user&.staff?

        render json: { error: "Only staff members can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
      end

      def paginate(scope)
        page = parse_positive_int(params[:page], DEFAULT_PAGE)
        per_page = [ parse_positive_int(params[:per_page], DEFAULT_PER_PAGE), MAX_PER_PAGE ].min

        total_count = scope.count
        offset = (page - 1) * per_page
        records = scope.limit(per_page).offset(offset).to_a

        {
          records: records,
          meta: {
            count: total_count,
            page: page,
            per_page: per_page,
            next_page: (page * per_page) < total_count ? page + 1 : nil,
            previous_page: page > 1 ? page - 1 : nil
          }
        }
      end

      def parse_positive_int(value, default)
        return default if value.blank?

        parsed = Integer(value.to_s, 10)

      rescue ArgumentError
        default
      end

        end

        if params.key?(:suspended) && params[:suspended].to_s != ""
          case params[:suspended].to_s.downcase
          when "true"
            scope = scope.suspended_only
          when "false"
            scope = scope.active
          else
            return render json: { error: "Invalid suspended filter" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          end
        end

        result = paginate(scope)
        render json: result[:meta].merge(
          users: result[:records].map(&:as_api_json)
        ), status: :ok
      end

      def show
        user = current_account.users.find(params[:id])
        render json: { user: user.as_api_json }, status: :ok
      end

      def update
        user = current_account.users.find(params[:id])
        user_attrs = params.require(:user)
        unless user_attrs.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
          return render json: { error: "Invalid user payload" }, status: :bad_request
        end

        permitted = user_attrs.permit(:suspended)
        unless permitted.key?(:suspended)
          return render json: { error: "Suspended status is required" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          current_account.lock!
          user.reload
          user.update!(suspended: permitted[:suspended])
        end

        render json: { user: user.reload.as_api_json }, status: :ok
      end
    end
